title: Exact answers, smoother keys, updates you control

highlights.title: Exact answers, instantly
highlights.text: √20 is 2√5, 2/√2 is √2, sin 60° is √3/2. The exact form appears as you type, works offline, and ⇄ always switches to the decimal.

highlights.title: Exact all the way
highlights.text: Continuing from an answer keeps it exact: 2√5 × √5 is exactly 10, not 9.999…

highlights.title: Swipe the key pages
highlights.text: 123, f(x), Calc, Phys, Units and abc lie side by side: swipe between them, or tap a tab. Keys react the moment you touch them.

highlights.title: Hold ⌫ to keep deleting
highlights.text: Hold the delete key or the cursor arrows and they repeat, faster after a moment.

highlights.title: Smoother everywhere
highlights.text: The formula glides into the history when you press =, settings slide up as a sheet, and the answer survives a tab switch or a reload.

highlights.title: Updates you control
highlights.text: The app no longer reloads itself. When a new version is ready you choose Update or Later, and this screen tells you what changed.

highlights.title: Textbook input and answers
highlights.text: Stacked fractions, roots and exponents; calculus and physics keys; a Desmos-like graph; units, constants, base, statistics and integer tools.
